protocol.state: F64LE actual native time,qpos10,qvel9; never logical time reconstruction; signed zero preserved
protocol.geometry: all native contacts, dim/exclude/address/index/pair/position/frame/distance and full compiled transforms; no newly solved forces
protocol.baselineMismatch: INCONCLUSIVE; no additional API, retry or retune
protocol.attribution: primary endpoint invalid => discrepancy already in direct query; valid primary and invalid normal witness => downstream locus only; no unique EPA/MultiCCD root cause
protocol.historical: all physical FAIL/GAP and D01/D02 remain unchanged; no physical pass, force or trajectory claim
protocol.later4732500: offline certificate only; no extra native pose

caps.policy: ONE module/two sequential original cases, four normal position plus four direct distance calls, zero dynamics. Four V1 lines plus four complete V2 query streams. Private diagnostic-only8visit/16vertex/24face profile within original N100 solver.192KiB recorder,512KiB stderr/query,2MiB stderr total,16MiB all durable duplicates plus error/footer. Overflow latches without changing C and forbids next API. No truncation acceptance/retry.

polytope.policy: Only initialized fields; exact original C computation continues after recorder failure, then harness stops before next API. Seed resets/reuse have separate epochs; monotonic snapshot bound begins at successful seed commit. No new native operation, solver flag, arithmetic feeding results or acceptance threshold.
polytope.seedSemantics: Chronological attempt/reset metadata and separate epochs precede complete initialized successful SEED_COMMIT. Discarded precommit trial arrays are not represented; all copied points/IDs used by the ACTIVE seed are retained in that commit. Snapshot monotonicity starts only there.

encoding.byteOrder: little-endian; raw I32/F64 bytes; U8 tags; no C padding
encoding.undefinedFields: zero placeholders are NOT observations; interpret only set defined bits
encoding.snapshotKindOrder: SEED_COMMIT then ordered SELECT/SUPPORT/HORIZON/ATTACH, EXIT; snapshots may omit later phases only when an original branch exits; original N100 continues after recorder failure.
